caseName: Empire Gas & Fuel Co. v. Wetsel
caseNameFull: Empire Gas & Fuel Company v. John G. Wetsel

opinions.text: October 11, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied. Mr. T. F. Garver and Mr. H. O. Caster for petitioner. No appearance for respondents.
